title: FemTheme Solo #017 · 여 레전더리 바스트·우즈벡실크로드글램·천사 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Uzbek woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, natural soft black hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold hammer head, a gold ship's anchor, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a tin cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above her head and a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at her back, a micro strapless white satin bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal white satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme white sculptural heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
